asks.name: gateway-already-attached
asks.message: Attaching my own gateway was refused and describe-internet-gateways shows net-shared-igw on this network, with a table net-shared-public-rt already sending 0.0.0.0/0 through it. Should the segments I am adding use that path instead of one of mine?

asks.name: block-taken
asks.message: The block I planned to use is inside 10.0.0.0/22, which describe-subnets shows held by data-plane-reserved. Do I move my segments elsewhere, or is that space available to me?

asks.name: booked-to-nobody
asks.message: My new segments came back stamped 2026-q3-unclaimed and booked to unallocated. What should they be charged to instead?

asks.name: exposure-mark
asks.message: Both segments now read per-instance-assignment in their tags. Is that how they are meant to stay, or may I put them back the way I set them up?

asks.name: effect-in-words
asks.message: Something switched off automatic public address assignment on the subnets I just made, re-tagged them, and put a second table on this network. Is there a standard behind any of that?

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
